input: Start a monthly book swap with close friends

gold.taskTitle: Launch a Monthly Book Swap With Close Friends
gold.taskDescription: Set up and run a recurring monthly book swap among a group of close friends.

questions.title: How many friends do you want to include?
questions.description: Understanding the group size shapes logistics like rotation order and communication tools.

questions.title: Will swaps happen in person or by mail?
questions.description: The delivery method affects cost, planning, and how books are exchanged each month.

questions.title: Does everyone swap one book, or multiple?
questions.description: Knowing the volume per swap helps define the rules and expectations for each round.

questions.title: Which month do you want to start this?
questions.description: A target start date helps work backward to set up invitations and the first round.

questions.title: Are there any genre or content restrictions to set?
questions.description: Agreeing on book types upfront prevents mismatched swaps and keeps everyone comfortable.

questions.title: Where will the group communicate and coordinate each month?
questions.description: Choosing a platform such as a group chat, app, or email keeps the swap organised.

questions.title: Will participants discuss or review books after reading?
questions.description: Deciding whether the swap includes a discussion element shapes the social format of the group.
